reply.emotion: matter-of-fact and helpful, pointing to one's own body
notes: Note that 'braço' refers to the upper limb from the shoulder to the hand, while 'mão' is just the hand.

senses.definition: O membro superior do corpo humano, desde o ombro até a mão.

examples.text: Ele machucou o braço jogando futebol.
examples.translation: He hurt his arm playing soccer.
examples.emotion: concerned and sympathetic, talking about an injury

senses.definition: A parte de uma peça de roupa que cobre este membro.

examples.text: A camisa tem manga comprida no braço.
examples.translation: The shirt has a long sleeve on the arm.
examples.emotion: describing a piece of clothing casually
